query_provenance: src/libstore/local-store.cc: QueryBlobInodes and lookupBlobSql, extracted verbatim
visibility_domain: 3 candidates x 2 executable classes; each absent/unnamed/named-invalid/registered
physical_class_domain: 2 executable classes x all 13 ordered three-candidate partitions x 64 visibility states; other mode independently present
query: select b.ino, b.id from Blobs b join Ingestions i on i.id = b.ingestion join ValidPaths v on v.path = i.path where not exists (select 1 from Blobs earlier join Ingestions ei on ei.id = earlier.ingestion join ValidPaths ev on ev.path = ei.path where earlier.id = b.id and earlier.exec = b.exec and (earlier.dev, earlier.ino, earlier.ingestion) < (b.dev, b.ino, b.ingestion));
lookup: select b.ino, b.dev, b.size, i.path, b.name, b.ingestion from Blobs b join Ingestions i on i.id = b.ingestion join ValidPaths v on v.path = i.path where b.id = ? and b.exec = ? and (b.dev, b.ino, b.ingestion) > (?, ?, ?) order by b.dev, b.ino, b.ingestion limit 1;
explain: SEARCH earlier USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_Blobs_1 (id=? AND exec=?)
SEARCH ei USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH ev USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_ValidPaths_1 (path=?)
SEARCH i USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH v USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_ValidPaths_1 (path=?)
lookup_explain: SEARCH b USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_Blobs_1 (id=? AND exec=?)
SEARCH i USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH v USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_ValidPaths_1 (path=?)
